text: The customer-support study reports about 15% greater resolutions per hour for 5,172 agents, with larger gains among less experienced workers.
limitations: Staggered rollout, primarily fall 2020 and winter 2021; 5,172 agents; adjusted estimate about 15%. One company, heterogeneous effects; not national employment evidence. Identification relies on parallel trends and related event-study assumptions, not verified universal assumptions.

text: METR reports an early-2025 slowdown and later selection and measurement problems that limit inference about newer productivity effects.

limitations: Early result concerns February–June 2025 tasks; later recruitment, task selection and concurrent-agent time measurement weaken interpretation. No universal current effect claimed.
